Proposition
[immortality of normalized surface Ricci flow] Source: cao-zhu 1. Proposition 5.1.3\group Normalized Ricci Flow on Surfaces

For any initial metric on a compact surface, the normalized Ricci flow $(5.1.1)$ has a solution for all time.
